description: Datadog monitor alert definitions for HelloTalk Virtual Coin Economy. Apply via `datadog-monitor` CLI or Terraform.

monitors.name: [HelloTalk] Coin Purchase Failure Rate
monitors.message:
Coin purchase failure rate exceeds 10% over the last 5 minutes. {{#is_alert}}Platform: {{platform.name}}, Reason: {{reason.name}} - Investigate payment gateway health.{{/is_alert}}
@oncall-monetisation

monitors.name: [HelloTalk] Coin Purchase Revenue Anomaly
monitors.message:
Coin purchase revenue has dropped significantly below the expected range over the last 30 minutes. {{#is_alert}}Platform: {{platform.name}} - Check if checkout is functional.{{/is_alert}}
@oncall-monetisation

monitors.name: [HelloTalk] Gift Send Rate Drop
monitors.message:
Gift sends have dropped below 1 per minute over the last 15 minutes. Zero gift sends may indicate a Centrifugo broadcast or economy service outage.
@oncall-monetisation

monitors.name: [HelloTalk] High-Value Coin Spend Spike (Fraud Detection)
monitors.message:
Unusually high coin spend detected on a single gift type in the last 5 minutes. {{#is_alert}}Gift ID: {{gift_id.name}}, Total coins spent: {{value}} - Potential abuse or exploit.{{/is_alert}}
@oncall-monetisation @oncall-security

monitors.name: [HelloTalk] Sticker Pack Unlock Failure Rate
monitors.message:
Sticker pack unlocks have suddenly stopped when they were previously active. Database or economy service issue suspected.
@oncall-monetisation

monitors.name: [HelloTalk] Datadog Agent Connectivity
monitors.message:
Datadog DogStatsD agent is not reporting metrics. Monitor data is stale for virtual coin economy alerts.
@oncall-infrastructure
